quests.title: The Silver Man's Tally
quests.blurb: Eight hours a day I don't move, which makes me the only one at this Quay who sees it move. There's a number chalked on a bollard down the western end. Photograph it before Monday gets to it. Don't look at me while I'm talking.

steps.label: get a flat white into you first -- you'll be standing still, and standing still is work
photograph the number chalked on the bollard at the western end of the Quay, before the week takes it
say the number back to him, out the side of your mouth
cross the bridge and have a proper look at who is on that train
find three people who remember last Sunday -- the ones who complain remember best
put $120 through the tin, because he reckons the tin is the only thing that carries over

quests.title: Whoever Stole My Car Is Blowing Zeroes
quests.blurb: Eleven months of fines and not one of them is mine. The booze bus on the Princes Highway has breath-tested my courtesy car three times this week. Three clean readings. Find me the better driver.

steps.label: walk the bought-out streets under the flight path, where the houses used to be
persuade the booze bus to share what its plate reader has been seeing
bring Narelle the printout and let her read it twice
catch the train down to Tempe, the way the thief plainly did
photograph it in the pram spot, wheels straight, for the release paperwork
earn the hundred and fifty release fee her own holding yard is charging her

quests.title: Is My Name Still On The Board
quests.blurb: One stop up the line there's a working-bee honour board in a club foyer with my name on it twice. I can't go and look. You can. Whole board, please, not just my bit.

steps.label: let Trev explain exactly what he wants photographed, and what you don't say at the desk
one stop up the line — he won't drive it, he sold the ute to the club raffle bloke
flat white from the good bakery on Queen Street, for Colleen on the desk
the club car park off Boronia Road, where the Sunday session sits out
four blokes want to know whose mate you are before you get near the door
the honour board in the foyer — the whole thing, in frame, no zooming
back down to the bench, front carriage, so he can see you coming

quests.title: The Booze Bus Outside a Street That Doesn't Drink
quests.blurb: Twenty-two years on Haldon Street and the strongest thing I have ever poured is the tea. They have parked the breath-test bus across from my window and my queue has gone home. Move it. Politely. Second tray is out at eleven.

steps.label: get up Haldon Street before the queue gives up
photograph the bus parked across from the window
hear what Wassim means by a distraction
give the breath testers something to test
survive what comes up the street after that
leave on the rails; the pursuit is a road unit
$160 off a street that suddenly needs lifts

quests.title: The Banner Goes in the Gap
quests.blurb: Someone drilled a ninety-year-old fig on New South Head Road and filled it with glyphosate. The fine is cheaper than the view. So we're doing the banner. I need an authorised person and you'll do.

steps.label: sign Form 10A in the wrong box
photograph the gap where the fig was
find the four crews who quoted on the removal
hold the consultation, $7.50 a cup
front the cost of the banner yourself
lodge it at the Land and Environment Court
bolt six metres of vinyl across the view

quests.title: Eleven Seconds at Homebush
quests.blurb: There's an inquiry into station staffing and my submission is one bloke's opinion in a font they don't like. Get me the platform, get me the crowd, get me back the fares those dead readers ate. Submissions close Friday.

steps.label: the eastern stairs at Homebush, before the 7:42
two from the platform cart; the second one is Des's
one stop, then change at Strathfield like it's 2009
photograph the change at Strathfield: the crowd is the case
see off four blokes doing a gate blitz on a dead reader
get $90 of eaten fares back out of the barriers
back to Des before submissions close at five

quests.title: The Price Guide Is a Guide
quests.blurb: Federation, four bed, walk to rail. Guide's one point nine; the reserve is not one point nine. I need Saturday to look busy, the drop saw next door to stop, and one photo of the back garden without the tenant's washing in it.

steps.label: get up to the Federation on the quiet side of the Pacific Highway before the ten o'clock open
two flat whites. Hugh does not run an open home on one, and he will not be buying
the renovation next door has a drop saw going through the whole inspection. Four blokes. Reason with them
photograph the back garden from the one corner where the tenant's washing is out of frame
ride it once, Wahroonga to Chatswood, so he can print 'nine minutes to Chatswood' and mean it
raise the two hundred of marketing yourself. The vendor has declined to fund marketing
eleven o'clock Saturday. Stand at the front and look like money

quests.title: Strictly Acoustic, Says the Permit
quests.blurb: Council signed off on an acoustic evening in the quarry. Acoustic. They never said how loud. Rig's in Waitara, the hole's in Hornsby, and I'm back on ward at seven.

steps.label: one stop to Waitara. Nobody on a Sydney train has ever asked what's in the bag
the loading dock under the Waitara towers, where my cousin keeps the generator between weddings
down Quarry Road while the gate's still open, and quietly, because the gate is the loudest thing here
ten a head on the rim. The gate is cash and tonight the gate is you
Wahroonga heard the bass at one. Four of them came down the fire trail in dressing gowns with a phone each
the booze bus parked itself at the top of Quarry Road at three, for the drive home that nobody here has
photograph the sun coming up over the hole, so council can see the evening stayed acoustic
the good coffee in the mall opens at six. Get two. One is for me and I am not asking

quests.title: Seven Trips Short of the Weekly Bonus
quests.blurb: Forty trips by Sunday and the bonus covers my rego. I'm on thirty-three and the car's on a hoist in Peakhurst. The app never asks what you turned up in. Take the phone, work the sheet, don't touch the aux cord.

quests.title: The Express Does Not Stop At Ashfield
quests.blurb: Out to Strathfield on the all stations, back on the all stations, and the express goes past us twice doing nothing for anybody. Knees are gone today. You're doing my run, and you're doing it properly.

steps.label: get his flat white, no sugar
ride out to Strathfield, all stations
photograph Strathfield for a man who's never seen it
make $60 on the way home, in fares like he does
